description: Price changes matched on domain, plan name, billing period and billing mode. Each row carries evidence_level: L1 = a person reopened the vendor page and checked both prices by hand; L2 = both dates' snapshots contain the price, machine-checked but not human-confirmed. Rows failing both are hidden unless include_unverified is set. kind="renamed" means a plan name change, not a price change.

include_unverified.description: Also return rows with no L1/L2 evidence (marked evidence_level=unverified)

since.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to last 90 days

name: price_changes
